Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip - June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIAL ITEMS:
- Passport/ID
- Travel documents
- Cash and credit cards
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer
- First aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Water shoes
- Beach umbrella
- Beach chair
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for electronics

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Trekking poles
- Daypack
- Extra water bottles
- Energy snacks
- Sun protection (hat, sunscreen, sunglasses)

CULTURAL & RELAXATION:
- Casual outfits (t-shirts, shorts, dresses)
- Light layers for air conditioning
- Evening wear for luau
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Spa attire

TECHNOLOGY:
- Camera with extra batteries
- Phone charger and power bank
- Camera memory cards
- Universal adapter

MEDICAL & PERSONAL:
- Prescription medications
- Over-the-counter medications
- Contact lens supplies
- Personal toiletries
- Hair dryer
- Travel pillow

ADDITIONAL ITEMS:
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)
- Book or e-reader
- Beach blanket
- Beach umbrella
- Beach chair
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for electronics
- Beach bag
- Beach towel
- Beach umbrella
- Beach chair
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for electronics

TRAVEL DAY:
- Overnight bag
- Comfortable travel clothes
- Snacks for the journey
- Entertainment for travel
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask
- Earplugs

TRIP DURATION: 10 days
DESTINATION: Hawaii
DATES: June 10-20, 2024
